Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an uninitialized memory read in the TGA image decoder that can expose memory contents. Attackers can supply a crafted TGA image for processing to disclose contents of uninitialized memory from the ImageMagick process.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in SVG encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the SVG encoder (WriteSVGImage) that fails to release allocated memory when handling crafted images. Attackers can supply crafted image files that are processed by the SVG encoder to leak memory and cause a denial of service through resource consumption.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via malformed XMP profile
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.1-7 before 7.1.2-32 contains a heap buffer over-read vulnerability that allows attackers to read beyond allocated memory due to incorrect string termination in XMP profiles. Attackers can supply a crafted image containing a malformed XMP profile to trigger the over-read and crash the application.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via crafted JPEG file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the JPEG decoder, which performs a read that exposes uninitialized memory when handling crafted input. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG file for processing to disclose uninitialized memory contents.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Code injection via crafted MVG file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a code injection vulnerability in the MVG decoder when a PostScript renderer is used. Attackers can supply a crafted MVG file that, when decoded, injects code into the PostScript rendering path.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via temporary file leak in JNG decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an incomplete cleanup flaw in the JNG decoder that fails to remove temporary files when processing crafted input. Attackers can submit crafted JNG files for processing to repeatedly leak temporary files, consuming disk space and degrading availability.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via crafted -fx expression
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.0-21 before 7.1.2-32 contains a heap buffer over-read in its handling of the -fx option, where a certain -fx operation reads beyond the bounds of an allocated heap buffer in specific situations. Attackers who can get a crafted -fx expression processed can read out-of-bounds heap memory, potentially disclosing limited memory contents.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Arbitrary code execution via crafted PICT image
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-33 and 6.9.13-58 contains a heap buffer underwrite vulnerability in DecodeImage() in coders/pict.c on 32-bit builds due to pointer arithmetic overflow. Attackers can supply a crafted PICT file with maximized row, column and bytes-per-line values to bypass bounds checks and write up to 128 controlled bytes below the heap buffer, causing crashes or code execution.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via heap buffer over-write in morphology operation with invalid kernel
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. In versions prior to 6.9.13-51 and 7.0.1-0 and above prior to 7.1.2-26, an invalid kernel can cause a heap buffer over-write when performing a morphology operation with a user supplied kernel. This issue has been fixed in versions 6.9.13-51 and 7.1.2-26.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted argument in fx operation
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. In versions prior to 7.1.2-27, a heap buffer over-write can occur in the fx operation by passing a crafted argument. This issue has been fixed in version 7.1.2-27.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Imagemagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via integer overflow in JNX decoder on 32-bit systems
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. In versions prior to both 6.9.13-52 and 7.1.2-27, processing an extremely large JNX file on 32-bit platforms can cause an integer overflow, leading to a heap buffer over-write. This issue has been fixed in versions 6.9.13-52 and 7.1.2-27.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information Disclosure via Crafted Image File
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. In versions prior to 7.1.2-27, the BGR decoder does not check for an end-of-file in every location so a crafted image could result in an heap buffer over-read. This issue has been fixed in version 7.1.2-27.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of service via heap-use-after-free in PerlMagick's GetList method
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.x before 6.9.13-55 contains a heap-use-after-free vulnerability in the GetList method of PerlMagick. A crafted call to the GetList method can trigger the use-after-free, resulting in a crash (denial of service).

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: PerlMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service due to heap-use-after-free vulnerability
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.x before 6.9.13-55 contains a heap-use-after-free vulnerability in the Layer method of PerlMagick. An attacker who supplies a crafted list of images can trigger memory access after deallocation, resulting in a crash (denial of service).

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via Null Pointer Dereference in PNM Coder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-31 and before 6.9.13-56 contains a NULL pointer dereference in the PNM coder. When the coder reaches a memory (resource) limit at a specific point during processing, the failed allocation is not handled and a NULL pointer is dereferenced, which can lead to a denial of service (application crash) when processing a specially crafted or sufficiently large PNM image.

Vulnerabilities.Title: A design flaw in image processing software that modifies JPEG images m ...
Vulnerabilities.Description: A design flaw in image processing software that modifies JPEG images might not modify the original EXIF thumbnail, which could lead to an information leak of potentially sensitive visual information that had been removed from the main JPEG image.

Vulnerabilities.Title: GraphicsMagick/ImageMagick: multiple crash or DoS issues
Vulnerabilities.Description: Multiple unspecified vulnerabilities in GraphicsMagick before 1.2.4 allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service (crash, infinite loop, or memory consumption) via (a) unspecified vectors in the (1) AVI, (2) AVS, (3) DCM, (4) EPT, (5) FITS, (6) MTV, (7) PALM, (8) RLA, and (9) TGA decoder readers; and (b) the GetImageCharacteristics function in magick/image.c, as reachable from a crafted (10) PNG, (11) JPEG, (12) BMP, or (13) TIFF file.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: Heap-buffer overflow in IsPixelMonochrome
Vulnerabilities.Description: The IsPixelMonochrome function in MagickCore/pixel-accessor.h in ImageMagick 7.0.3.0 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (out-of-bounds read and crash) via a crafted file.  NOTE: the vendor says "This is a Q64 issue and we do not support Q64."

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: Memory leak in WritePICONImage function
Vulnerabilities.Description: The WritePICONImage function in coders/xpm.c in ImageMagick 7.0.6-4 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak) via a crafted file that is mishandled in an OpenPixelCache call.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: Memory leak in WritePICONImage function via mishandled AcquireSemaphoreInfo call
Vulnerabilities.Description: The WritePICONImage function in coders/xpm.c in ImageMagick 7.0.6-4 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak) via a crafted file that is mishandled in an AcquireSemaphoreInfo call.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: Memory allocation failure in AcquireMagickMemory (incomplete fix for  CVE-2016-8866)
Vulnerabilities.Description: The ReadPCXImage function in coders/pcx.c in ImageMagick 7.0.4.9 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (attempted large memory allocation and application crash) via a crafted file. NOTE: this vulnerability exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2016-8862 and CVE-2016-8866.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: CPU Exhaustion via crafted input file
Vulnerabilities.Description: In ImageMagick 7.0.8-11 Q16, a tiny input file 0x50 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x4c 0x36 0x38 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x1f 0x35 0x50 0x00 can result in a hang of several minutes during which CPU and memory resources are consumed until ultimately an attempted large memory allocation fails. Remote attackers could leverage this vulnerability to cause a denial of service via a crafted file.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: RCE (shell command injection) vulnerability in OpenBlob with --enable-pipes configured
Vulnerabilities.Description: A vulnerability was found in ImageMagick. This security flaw cause a remote code execution vulnerability in OpenBlob with --enable-pipes configured.

Vulnerabilities.Title: imagemagick: ImageMagick: Undefined Behavior
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to versions 6.9.13-27 and 7.1.2-1, there is undefined behavior (function-type-mismatch) in splay tree cloning callback. This results in a deterministic abort under UBSan (DoS in sanitizer builds), with no crash in a non-sanitized build. This issue has been patched in versions 6.9.13-27 and 7.1.2-1.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Security policy bypass via symbolic link
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-58 and 7.x before 7.1.2-33 does not properly account for symbolic links in the IsRightsAuthorizedByName security policy check, allowing configured policy restrictions to be bypassed. Local attackers who can create a symlink can point it at a policy-restricted path to evade the configured policy.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via invalid memory free in fx operation
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 contains an invalid memory free vulnerability in the fx operation that occurs when initialization of an FX runtime entry fails. Attackers can trigger the failed FX runtime initialization to cause an invalid free, resulting in memory corruption and application crashes.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in PNG encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the PNG encoder, which does not release allocated memory when libpng initialization fails. Attackers who can repeatedly trigger PNG encoding operations in which libpng initialization fails can exhaust memory and cause a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in GIF encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the GIF encoder because allocated memory is not released when color quantization fails during encoding. Attackers can supply images whose GIF conversion causes quantization to fail, leaking memory with each attempt and degrading availability.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in YUV encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the YUV encoder, which fails to release allocated memory when a specific operation fails. Attackers can supply crafted input that triggers the failing encoder operation, leaking memory and potentially exhausting resources to cause a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via uncontrolled recursion in MVG decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains uncontrolled recursion in the MVG decoder that can exhaust the program stack. An attacker who controls a file name processed by ImageMagick can trigger a stack overflow that crashes the process, causing a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via stack overflow in MSL decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a stack overflow in the MSL decoder caused by an incorrect depth check that fails to limit recursion. Attackers can supply a set of crafted MSL images that exhaust the stack when one of them is read, crashing the process and causing a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via use-after-free in PDF writer
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a use after free vulnerability in the PDF writer when writing CMYK images with JPEG2000 compression. Attackers can supply a crafted CMYK image that, when written to PDF with JPEG2000 compression, causes freed memory to be reused, potentially crashing the process.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in the -process option
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak vulnerability in the -process option that allows attackers to cause unreleased memory allocations by supplying certain arguments. Attackers can repeatedly invoke the -process option with crafted arguments to gradually exhaust memory and degrade service availability.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of service via use-after-free in the WBINFO decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.2-30 before 7.1.2-32 contains a use after free vulnerability in the WBINFO decoder that occurs when a memory allocation fails during image decoding. Attackers can supply a crafted image that, when decoded under memory allocation failure conditions, causes freed memory to be reused, crashing the application.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted PostScript file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.1-31 before 7.1.2-32 contains a NULL pointer dereference in the PostScript decoder that is triggered when a policy limit is reached. Attackers can supply a crafted PostScript file for processing to crash the application, causing a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via crafted PostScript file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the PostScript decoder, which allocates a buffer one byte longer than the data it decoded. Attackers can supply a crafted PostScript file to expose a single uninitialized byte of memory contents.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Security policy bypass via TOCTOU symlink race condition
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 contains a time-of-check time-of-use symlink race vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass the path security policy when executing a magick script. Attackers can swap a checked path with a symlink during script execution to read files that the security policy is meant to block.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Security policy bypass via -script operation
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 contains a policy bypass vulnerability in the -script operation due to missing checks on file descriptor handling. Attackers can use the -script operation to close file descriptors not opened by the current operation, circumventing configured security policies.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in wavelet-denoise operation
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the wavelet-denoise operation, which fails to release allocated memory when a required resource cannot be acquired. Attackers can repeatedly trigger wavelet-denoise processing under resource-constrained conditions to leak memory and degrade service availability.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via race condition during security policy access
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 lacks proper synchronization when the security policy is accessed, so simultaneous reads and writes of the policy by multiple threads trigger a race condition that causes a heap buffer over-write. An attacker able to induce concurrent security policy access can crash the application, causing a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via use-after-free in -fx option
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 contains a use after free vulnerability in the -fx option that occurs when a memory allocation fails during a specific operation. Attackers who can supply crafted -fx expressions under memory pressure can trigger freed memory access, causing crashes or memory corruption.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via type confusion in INFO, JSON, and YAML encoders
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a type confusion flaw in the INFO, JSON and YAML encoders, where an internal method receives a pointer of an unexpected type when writing an image in a compressed format. An attacker who can cause such an image write can trigger a SIGABRT or SIGSEGV, crashing the process and causing denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Imagemagick: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-27 Memory Leak via Invalid CLI Options
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-27 contains a memory leak vulnerability in the magick command-line interface when invalid options are provided. Attackers can trigger memory exhaustion by repeatedly supplying malformed command-line arguments to consume system resources.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Local attacker can modify files via TOCTOU symlink race
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55 contains a time-of-check-time-of-use (TOCTOU) vulnerability in the video decoder that allows attackers to bypass path policy write restrictions via symlink swaps. An attacker can replace a symlink between policy validation (check-time) and the file write operation (use-time) to write to policy-denied locations.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via Use After Free in ImagesToBlob
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-31 and before 6.9.13-56 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the ImagesToBlob method, caused by a pointer that is not updated correctly. Exploitation may result in a limited availability impact (e.g., a crash of the affected process). The issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Local user can cause denial of service via policy bypass in image decoders
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-31 and before 6.9.13-56 contains a policy bypass in the PCD (and, per the upstream advisory, CUBE and HALD) coder: when a specific command line option is supplied, the decoder does not check a configured resource limit, which can result in extra memory allocation. A local user able to pass command line options to ImageMagick can therefore exceed the intended memory policy limit, causing a limited availability impact. The issue is fixed in 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an XML i ...
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an XML injection vulnerability in the CIP encoder, which does not properly escape input-derived data when writing Cisco IP Phone XML output. Attackers can supply a crafted file that, when converted to CIP format, injects arbitrary markup into the generated XML.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via missing end-of-file check in bzip2 images
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57, a missing end-of-file check while reading bzip2-compressed image data can cause an infinite loop and exhaust processing resources. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted PSD file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57, a crafted PSD file can trigger an integer-conversion error in the PSD decoder on 32-bit builds, causing an infinite loop and denial of service. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via missing limit check in MVG decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56, a missing limit check in the MVG decoder allows a crafted MVG image to trigger an excessively long-running operation. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted XMP profile
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31, a crafted XMP profile can trigger excessive work while the parser determines a rational value's numerator and denominator, causing denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 7.1.2-31.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via invalid memory free in MVG decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56, a crafted image can cause an invalid memory free in the MVG decoder and crash the process. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via security policy bypass
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56, a crafted image can bypass an ImageMagick security policy that uses coder as its domain, potentially allowing data prohibited by the policy to be read. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via missing security policy check in CUT encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56, a missing security-policy check in the CUT encoder allows a crafted local encoding operation to read data that policy should deny and can also cause a crash. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted RSVG image
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55, when ImageMagick is built without Cairo support, a crafted RSVG image that reaches a resource limit can cause the RSVG decoder to free image state twice and then use freed memory, crashing the process. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service due to memory budget exhaustion
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55 fails to properly lower the memory budget when an operation inside OpenPixelCache fails. Repeated triggering of such failures can exhaust the process memory budget and result in a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in MSL decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55 contains a memory leak in the MSL image decoder. A crafted MSL image triggers memory allocation without proper deallocation, allowing an attacker to exhaust memory and cause a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via division by zero in FLIF encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56 contains a division-by-zero flaw in the FLIF encoder. An incorrect value for ticks per second in the image being encoded causes a divide-by-zero and crashes the encoder, resulting in a denial of service. The issue is fixed in 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via UHDR encoder policy bypass
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-31 contains a policy bypass vulnerability in the UHDR encoder that fails to perform policy checks during buffer allocation for image pixels. Attackers can bypass resource policies by processing specially crafted UHDR images, potentially causing denial of service through excessive memory allocation.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via crafted GIF file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick versions before 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57 contain uninitialized heap memory disclosure in the GIF decoder's application extension handler in coders/gif.c. Attackers can craft malicious GIF files that cause the number parser to read uninitialized heap memory and store contents as image metadata, disclosing sensitive heap information.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Security policy bypass via alternate XML DOCTYPE declaration
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57 contains a policy bypass vulnerability in LoadPolicyCache that silently skips security policy rules when policy.xml uses an alternate DOCTYPE. A valid DOCTYPE not ending in ']>' makes the parser consume the rest of the file, so no policy rules are applied and restricted operations become allowed.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted EXR image
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-32, a crafted EXR image can cause the EXR decoder to write beyond a heap buffer, causing the process to crash. This issue is fixed in version 7.1.2-32.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: File overwrite via improper delegate symlink cleanup
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-32, delegate symlink cleanup does not check the MAGICK_SHRED_PASSES environment variable, allowing a local privileged workflow to overwrite a file with random data. This issue is fixed in version 7.1.2-32.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted XMP profile
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57, a crafted XMP profile embedded in an image can cause the profile parser to enter an infinite loop, preventing image processing from completing. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via connection exhaustion in distributed pixel cache
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-32, an unauthenticated adjacent-network client can repeatedly connect to the distributed pixel cache server and exhaust its available connections, causing denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 7.1.2-32.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via heap buffer overflow in GetVirtualPixels
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 6.9.13-56 and 7.1.2-31, a crafted local call to the GetVirtualPixels API can trigger an integer calculation error and write beyond a heap buffer, crashing the server process. This issue is fixed in versions 6.9.13-56 and 7.1.2-31.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted CALS image
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55, a missing recursion-depth check in the CALS decoder allows a crafted CALS image to exhaust the call stack and terminate the process. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via heap buffer overwrite in distributed pixel cache server
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31, a client connected to the distributed pixel cache server can send crafted pixel data that triggers an integer-size calculation error and a heap buffer overwrite, crashing the server. This issue is fixed in version 7.1.2-31.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via unclosed file pointers in Magick scripts
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31, a crafted Magick script can cause an opened file pointer to remain unclosed, allowing repeated processing to exhaust available file descriptors. This issue is fixed in version 7.1.2-31.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Code injection via unescaped values in PostScript coders
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56, unescaped or untrimmed values can inject code into output generated by PostScript coders. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted XMP profile
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55, a crafted XMP profile can reach a recursion limit that is handled as a fatal condition instead of an ordinary exception, terminating the image-processing process. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Resource exhaustion via crafted MAT image
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55, a crafted highly compressed MAT image can make the MAT decoder create temporary files larger than the configured security-policy limit, bypassing resource restrictions and consuming excessive disk space. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via crafted TGA image
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an uninitialized memory read in the TGA image decoder that can expose memory contents. Attackers can supply a crafted TGA image for processing to disclose contents of uninitialized memory from the ImageMagick process.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in SVG encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the SVG encoder (WriteSVGImage) that fails to release allocated memory when handling crafted images. Attackers can supply crafted image files that are processed by the SVG encoder to leak memory and cause a denial of service through resource consumption.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via malformed XMP profile
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.1-7 before 7.1.2-32 contains a heap buffer over-read vulnerability that allows attackers to read beyond allocated memory due to incorrect string termination in XMP profiles. Attackers can supply a crafted image containing a malformed XMP profile to trigger the over-read and crash the application.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via crafted JPEG file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the JPEG decoder, which performs a read that exposes uninitialized memory when handling crafted input. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG file for processing to disclose uninitialized memory contents.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Code injection via crafted MVG file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a code injection vulnerability in the MVG decoder when a PostScript renderer is used. Attackers can supply a crafted MVG file that, when decoded, injects code into the PostScript rendering path.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via temporary file leak in JNG decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an incomplete cleanup flaw in the JNG decoder that fails to remove temporary files when processing crafted input. Attackers can submit crafted JNG files for processing to repeatedly leak temporary files, consuming disk space and degrading availability.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via crafted -fx expression
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.0-21 before 7.1.2-32 contains a heap buffer over-read in its handling of the -fx option, where a certain -fx operation reads beyond the bounds of an allocated heap buffer in specific situations. Attackers who can get a crafted -fx expression processed can read out-of-bounds heap memory, potentially disclosing limited memory contents.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Arbitrary code execution via crafted PICT image
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-33 and 6.9.13-58 contains a heap buffer underwrite vulnerability in DecodeImage() in coders/pict.c on 32-bit builds due to pointer arithmetic overflow. Attackers can supply a crafted PICT file with maximized row, column and bytes-per-line values to bypass bounds checks and write up to 128 controlled bytes below the heap buffer, causing crashes or code execution.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via heap buffer over-write in morphology operation with invalid kernel
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. In versions prior to 6.9.13-51 and 7.0.1-0 and above prior to 7.1.2-26, an invalid kernel can cause a heap buffer over-write when performing a morphology operation with a user supplied kernel. This issue has been fixed in versions 6.9.13-51 and 7.1.2-26.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted argument in fx operation
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. In versions prior to 7.1.2-27, a heap buffer over-write can occur in the fx operation by passing a crafted argument. This issue has been fixed in version 7.1.2-27.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Imagemagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via integer overflow in JNX decoder on 32-bit systems
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. In versions prior to both 6.9.13-52 and 7.1.2-27, processing an extremely large JNX file on 32-bit platforms can cause an integer overflow, leading to a heap buffer over-write. This issue has been fixed in versions 6.9.13-52 and 7.1.2-27.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information Disclosure via Crafted Image File
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. In versions prior to 7.1.2-27, the BGR decoder does not check for an end-of-file in every location so a crafted image could result in an heap buffer over-read. This issue has been fixed in version 7.1.2-27.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of service via heap-use-after-free in PerlMagick's GetList method
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.x before 6.9.13-55 contains a heap-use-after-free vulnerability in the GetList method of PerlMagick. A crafted call to the GetList method can trigger the use-after-free, resulting in a crash (denial of service).

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: PerlMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service due to heap-use-after-free vulnerability
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.x before 6.9.13-55 contains a heap-use-after-free vulnerability in the Layer method of PerlMagick. An attacker who supplies a crafted list of images can trigger memory access after deallocation, resulting in a crash (denial of service).

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via Null Pointer Dereference in PNM Coder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-31 and before 6.9.13-56 contains a NULL pointer dereference in the PNM coder. When the coder reaches a memory (resource) limit at a specific point during processing, the failed allocation is not handled and a NULL pointer is dereferenced, which can lead to a denial of service (application crash) when processing a specially crafted or sufficiently large PNM image.

Vulnerabilities.Title: A design flaw in image processing software that modifies JPEG images m ...
Vulnerabilities.Description: A design flaw in image processing software that modifies JPEG images might not modify the original EXIF thumbnail, which could lead to an information leak of potentially sensitive visual information that had been removed from the main JPEG image.

Vulnerabilities.Title: GraphicsMagick/ImageMagick: multiple crash or DoS issues
Vulnerabilities.Description: Multiple unspecified vulnerabilities in GraphicsMagick before 1.2.4 allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service (crash, infinite loop, or memory consumption) via (a) unspecified vectors in the (1) AVI, (2) AVS, (3) DCM, (4) EPT, (5) FITS, (6) MTV, (7) PALM, (8) RLA, and (9) TGA decoder readers; and (b) the GetImageCharacteristics function in magick/image.c, as reachable from a crafted (10) PNG, (11) JPEG, (12) BMP, or (13) TIFF file.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: Heap-buffer overflow in IsPixelMonochrome
Vulnerabilities.Description: The IsPixelMonochrome function in MagickCore/pixel-accessor.h in ImageMagick 7.0.3.0 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (out-of-bounds read and crash) via a crafted file.  NOTE: the vendor says "This is a Q64 issue and we do not support Q64."

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: Memory leak in WritePICONImage function
Vulnerabilities.Description: The WritePICONImage function in coders/xpm.c in ImageMagick 7.0.6-4 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak) via a crafted file that is mishandled in an OpenPixelCache call.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: Memory leak in WritePICONImage function via mishandled AcquireSemaphoreInfo call
Vulnerabilities.Description: The WritePICONImage function in coders/xpm.c in ImageMagick 7.0.6-4 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak) via a crafted file that is mishandled in an AcquireSemaphoreInfo call.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: Memory allocation failure in AcquireMagickMemory (incomplete fix for  CVE-2016-8866)
Vulnerabilities.Description: The ReadPCXImage function in coders/pcx.c in ImageMagick 7.0.4.9 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (attempted large memory allocation and application crash) via a crafted file. NOTE: this vulnerability exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2016-8862 and CVE-2016-8866.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: CPU Exhaustion via crafted input file
Vulnerabilities.Description: In ImageMagick 7.0.8-11 Q16, a tiny input file 0x50 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x4c 0x36 0x38 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x1f 0x35 0x50 0x00 can result in a hang of several minutes during which CPU and memory resources are consumed until ultimately an attempted large memory allocation fails. Remote attackers could leverage this vulnerability to cause a denial of service via a crafted file.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: RCE (shell command injection) vulnerability in OpenBlob with --enable-pipes configured
Vulnerabilities.Description: A vulnerability was found in ImageMagick. This security flaw cause a remote code execution vulnerability in OpenBlob with --enable-pipes configured.

Vulnerabilities.Title: imagemagick: ImageMagick: Undefined Behavior
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to versions 6.9.13-27 and 7.1.2-1, there is undefined behavior (function-type-mismatch) in splay tree cloning callback. This results in a deterministic abort under UBSan (DoS in sanitizer builds), with no crash in a non-sanitized build. This issue has been patched in versions 6.9.13-27 and 7.1.2-1.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Security policy bypass via symbolic link
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-58 and 7.x before 7.1.2-33 does not properly account for symbolic links in the IsRightsAuthorizedByName security policy check, allowing configured policy restrictions to be bypassed. Local attackers who can create a symlink can point it at a policy-restricted path to evade the configured policy.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via invalid memory free in fx operation
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 contains an invalid memory free vulnerability in the fx operation that occurs when initialization of an FX runtime entry fails. Attackers can trigger the failed FX runtime initialization to cause an invalid free, resulting in memory corruption and application crashes.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in PNG encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the PNG encoder, which does not release allocated memory when libpng initialization fails. Attackers who can repeatedly trigger PNG encoding operations in which libpng initialization fails can exhaust memory and cause a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in GIF encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the GIF encoder because allocated memory is not released when color quantization fails during encoding. Attackers can supply images whose GIF conversion causes quantization to fail, leaking memory with each attempt and degrading availability.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in YUV encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the YUV encoder, which fails to release allocated memory when a specific operation fails. Attackers can supply crafted input that triggers the failing encoder operation, leaking memory and potentially exhausting resources to cause a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via uncontrolled recursion in MVG decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains uncontrolled recursion in the MVG decoder that can exhaust the program stack. An attacker who controls a file name processed by ImageMagick can trigger a stack overflow that crashes the process, causing a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via stack overflow in MSL decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a stack overflow in the MSL decoder caused by an incorrect depth check that fails to limit recursion. Attackers can supply a set of crafted MSL images that exhaust the stack when one of them is read, crashing the process and causing a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via use-after-free in PDF writer
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a use after free vulnerability in the PDF writer when writing CMYK images with JPEG2000 compression. Attackers can supply a crafted CMYK image that, when written to PDF with JPEG2000 compression, causes freed memory to be reused, potentially crashing the process.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in the -process option
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak vulnerability in the -process option that allows attackers to cause unreleased memory allocations by supplying certain arguments. Attackers can repeatedly invoke the -process option with crafted arguments to gradually exhaust memory and degrade service availability.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of service via use-after-free in the WBINFO decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.2-30 before 7.1.2-32 contains a use after free vulnerability in the WBINFO decoder that occurs when a memory allocation fails during image decoding. Attackers can supply a crafted image that, when decoded under memory allocation failure conditions, causes freed memory to be reused, crashing the application.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted PostScript file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.1-31 before 7.1.2-32 contains a NULL pointer dereference in the PostScript decoder that is triggered when a policy limit is reached. Attackers can supply a crafted PostScript file for processing to crash the application, causing a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via crafted PostScript file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the PostScript decoder, which allocates a buffer one byte longer than the data it decoded. Attackers can supply a crafted PostScript file to expose a single uninitialized byte of memory contents.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Security policy bypass via TOCTOU symlink race condition
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 contains a time-of-check time-of-use symlink race vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass the path security policy when executing a magick script. Attackers can swap a checked path with a symlink during script execution to read files that the security policy is meant to block.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Security policy bypass via -script operation
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 contains a policy bypass vulnerability in the -script operation due to missing checks on file descriptor handling. Attackers can use the -script operation to close file descriptors not opened by the current operation, circumventing configured security policies.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in wavelet-denoise operation
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the wavelet-denoise operation, which fails to release allocated memory when a required resource cannot be acquired. Attackers can repeatedly trigger wavelet-denoise processing under resource-constrained conditions to leak memory and degrade service availability.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via race condition during security policy access
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 lacks proper synchronization when the security policy is accessed, so simultaneous reads and writes of the policy by multiple threads trigger a race condition that causes a heap buffer over-write. An attacker able to induce concurrent security policy access can crash the application, causing a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via use-after-free in -fx option
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 contains a use after free vulnerability in the -fx option that occurs when a memory allocation fails during a specific operation. Attackers who can supply crafted -fx expressions under memory pressure can trigger freed memory access, causing crashes or memory corruption.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via type confusion in INFO, JSON, and YAML encoders
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a type confusion flaw in the INFO, JSON and YAML encoders, where an internal method receives a pointer of an unexpected type when writing an image in a compressed format. An attacker who can cause such an image write can trigger a SIGABRT or SIGSEGV, crashing the process and causing denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Imagemagick: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-27 Memory Leak via Invalid CLI Options
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-27 contains a memory leak vulnerability in the magick command-line interface when invalid options are provided. Attackers can trigger memory exhaustion by repeatedly supplying malformed command-line arguments to consume system resources.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Local attacker can modify files via TOCTOU symlink race
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55 contains a time-of-check-time-of-use (TOCTOU) vulnerability in the video decoder that allows attackers to bypass path policy write restrictions via symlink swaps. An attacker can replace a symlink between policy validation (check-time) and the file write operation (use-time) to write to policy-denied locations.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via Use After Free in ImagesToBlob
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-31 and before 6.9.13-56 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the ImagesToBlob method, caused by a pointer that is not updated correctly. Exploitation may result in a limited availability impact (e.g., a crash of the affected process). The issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Local user can cause denial of service via policy bypass in image decoders
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-31 and before 6.9.13-56 contains a policy bypass in the PCD (and, per the upstream advisory, CUBE and HALD) coder: when a specific command line option is supplied, the decoder does not check a configured resource limit, which can result in extra memory allocation. A local user able to pass command line options to ImageMagick can therefore exceed the intended memory policy limit, causing a limited availability impact. The issue is fixed in 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an XML i ...
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an XML injection vulnerability in the CIP encoder, which does not properly escape input-derived data when writing Cisco IP Phone XML output. Attackers can supply a crafted file that, when converted to CIP format, injects arbitrary markup into the generated XML.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via missing end-of-file check in bzip2 images
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57, a missing end-of-file check while reading bzip2-compressed image data can cause an infinite loop and exhaust processing resources. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted PSD file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57, a crafted PSD file can trigger an integer-conversion error in the PSD decoder on 32-bit builds, causing an infinite loop and denial of service. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via missing limit check in MVG decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56, a missing limit check in the MVG decoder allows a crafted MVG image to trigger an excessively long-running operation. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted XMP profile
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31, a crafted XMP profile can trigger excessive work while the parser determines a rational value's numerator and denominator, causing denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 7.1.2-31.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via invalid memory free in MVG decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56, a crafted image can cause an invalid memory free in the MVG decoder and crash the process. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via security policy bypass
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56, a crafted image can bypass an ImageMagick security policy that uses coder as its domain, potentially allowing data prohibited by the policy to be read. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via missing security policy check in CUT encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56, a missing security-policy check in the CUT encoder allows a crafted local encoding operation to read data that policy should deny and can also cause a crash. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted RSVG image
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55, when ImageMagick is built without Cairo support, a crafted RSVG image that reaches a resource limit can cause the RSVG decoder to free image state twice and then use freed memory, crashing the process. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service due to memory budget exhaustion
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55 fails to properly lower the memory budget when an operation inside OpenPixelCache fails. Repeated triggering of such failures can exhaust the process memory budget and result in a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in MSL decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55 contains a memory leak in the MSL image decoder. A crafted MSL image triggers memory allocation without proper deallocation, allowing an attacker to exhaust memory and cause a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via division by zero in FLIF encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56 contains a division-by-zero flaw in the FLIF encoder. An incorrect value for ticks per second in the image being encoded causes a divide-by-zero and crashes the encoder, resulting in a denial of service. The issue is fixed in 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via UHDR encoder policy bypass
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-31 contains a policy bypass vulnerability in the UHDR encoder that fails to perform policy checks during buffer allocation for image pixels. Attackers can bypass resource policies by processing specially crafted UHDR images, potentially causing denial of service through excessive memory allocation.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via crafted GIF file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick versions before 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57 contain uninitialized heap memory disclosure in the GIF decoder's application extension handler in coders/gif.c. Attackers can craft malicious GIF files that cause the number parser to read uninitialized heap memory and store contents as image metadata, disclosing sensitive heap information.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Security policy bypass via alternate XML DOCTYPE declaration
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57 contains a policy bypass vulnerability in LoadPolicyCache that silently skips security policy rules when policy.xml uses an alternate DOCTYPE. A valid DOCTYPE not ending in ']>' makes the parser consume the rest of the file, so no policy rules are applied and restricted operations become allowed.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted EXR image
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-32, a crafted EXR image can cause the EXR decoder to write beyond a heap buffer, causing the process to crash. This issue is fixed in version 7.1.2-32.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: File overwrite via improper delegate symlink cleanup
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-32, delegate symlink cleanup does not check the MAGICK_SHRED_PASSES environment variable, allowing a local privileged workflow to overwrite a file with random data. This issue is fixed in version 7.1.2-32.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted XMP profile
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57, a crafted XMP profile embedded in an image can cause the profile parser to enter an infinite loop, preventing image processing from completing. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-32 and 6.9.13-57.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via connection exhaustion in distributed pixel cache
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-32, an unauthenticated adjacent-network client can repeatedly connect to the distributed pixel cache server and exhaust its available connections, causing denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 7.1.2-32.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via heap buffer overflow in GetVirtualPixels
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 6.9.13-56 and 7.1.2-31, a crafted local call to the GetVirtualPixels API can trigger an integer calculation error and write beyond a heap buffer, crashing the server process. This issue is fixed in versions 6.9.13-56 and 7.1.2-31.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted CALS image
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55, a missing recursion-depth check in the CALS decoder allows a crafted CALS image to exhaust the call stack and terminate the process. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via heap buffer overwrite in distributed pixel cache server
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31, a client connected to the distributed pixel cache server can send crafted pixel data that triggers an integer-size calculation error and a heap buffer overwrite, crashing the server. This issue is fixed in version 7.1.2-31.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via unclosed file pointers in Magick scripts
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31, a crafted Magick script can cause an opened file pointer to remain unclosed, allowing repeated processing to exhaust available file descriptors. This issue is fixed in version 7.1.2-31.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Code injection via unescaped values in PostScript coders
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56, unescaped or untrimmed values can inject code into output generated by PostScript coders. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-31 and 6.9.13-56.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted XMP profile
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55, a crafted XMP profile can reach a recursion limit that is handled as a fatal condition instead of an ordinary exception, terminating the image-processing process. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Resource exhaustion via crafted MAT image
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55, a crafted highly compressed MAT image can make the MAT decoder create temporary files larger than the configured security-policy limit, bypassing resource restrictions and consuming excessive disk space. This issue is fixed in versions 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.13-55.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via crafted TGA image
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an uninitialized memory read in the TGA image decoder that can expose memory contents. Attackers can supply a crafted TGA image for processing to disclose contents of uninitialized memory from the ImageMagick process.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in SVG encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the SVG encoder (WriteSVGImage) that fails to release allocated memory when handling crafted images. Attackers can supply crafted image files that are processed by the SVG encoder to leak memory and cause a denial of service through resource consumption.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via malformed XMP profile
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.1-7 before 7.1.2-32 contains a heap buffer over-read vulnerability that allows attackers to read beyond allocated memory due to incorrect string termination in XMP profiles. Attackers can supply a crafted image containing a malformed XMP profile to trigger the over-read and crash the application.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via crafted JPEG file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the JPEG decoder, which performs a read that exposes uninitialized memory when handling crafted input. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG file for processing to disclose uninitialized memory contents.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Code injection via crafted MVG file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a code injection vulnerability in the MVG decoder when a PostScript renderer is used. Attackers can supply a crafted MVG file that, when decoded, injects code into the PostScript rendering path.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via temporary file leak in JNG decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an incomplete cleanup flaw in the JNG decoder that fails to remove temporary files when processing crafted input. Attackers can submit crafted JNG files for processing to repeatedly leak temporary files, consuming disk space and degrading availability.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via crafted -fx expression
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.0-21 before 7.1.2-32 contains a heap buffer over-read in its handling of the -fx option, where a certain -fx operation reads beyond the bounds of an allocated heap buffer in specific situations. Attackers who can get a crafted -fx expression processed can read out-of-bounds heap memory, potentially disclosing limited memory contents.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Arbitrary code execution via crafted PICT image
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-33 and 6.9.13-58 contains a heap buffer underwrite vulnerability in DecodeImage() in coders/pict.c on 32-bit builds due to pointer arithmetic overflow. Attackers can supply a crafted PICT file with maximized row, column and bytes-per-line values to bypass bounds checks and write up to 128 controlled bytes below the heap buffer, causing crashes or code execution.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via heap buffer over-write in morphology operation with invalid kernel
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. In versions prior to 6.9.13-51 and 7.0.1-0 and above prior to 7.1.2-26, an invalid kernel can cause a heap buffer over-write when performing a morphology operation with a user supplied kernel. This issue has been fixed in versions 6.9.13-51 and 7.1.2-26.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted argument in fx operation
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. In versions prior to 7.1.2-27, a heap buffer over-write can occur in the fx operation by passing a crafted argument. This issue has been fixed in version 7.1.2-27.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Imagemagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via integer overflow in JNX decoder on 32-bit systems
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. In versions prior to both 6.9.13-52 and 7.1.2-27, processing an extremely large JNX file on 32-bit platforms can cause an integer overflow, leading to a heap buffer over-write. This issue has been fixed in versions 6.9.13-52 and 7.1.2-27.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information Disclosure via Crafted Image File
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. In versions prior to 7.1.2-27, the BGR decoder does not check for an end-of-file in every location so a crafted image could result in an heap buffer over-read. This issue has been fixed in version 7.1.2-27.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of service via heap-use-after-free in PerlMagick's GetList method
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.x before 6.9.13-55 contains a heap-use-after-free vulnerability in the GetList method of PerlMagick. A crafted call to the GetList method can trigger the use-after-free, resulting in a crash (denial of service).

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: PerlMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service due to heap-use-after-free vulnerability
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-30 and 6.9.x before 6.9.13-55 contains a heap-use-after-free vulnerability in the Layer method of PerlMagick. An attacker who supplies a crafted list of images can trigger memory access after deallocation, resulting in a crash (denial of service).

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via Null Pointer Dereference in PNM Coder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-31 and before 6.9.13-56 contains a NULL pointer dereference in the PNM coder. When the coder reaches a memory (resource) limit at a specific point during processing, the failed allocation is not handled and a NULL pointer is dereferenced, which can lead to a denial of service (application crash) when processing a specially crafted or sufficiently large PNM image.

Vulnerabilities.Title: A design flaw in image processing software that modifies JPEG images m ...
Vulnerabilities.Description: A design flaw in image processing software that modifies JPEG images might not modify the original EXIF thumbnail, which could lead to an information leak of potentially sensitive visual information that had been removed from the main JPEG image.

Vulnerabilities.Title: GraphicsMagick/ImageMagick: multiple crash or DoS issues
Vulnerabilities.Description: Multiple unspecified vulnerabilities in GraphicsMagick before 1.2.4 allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service (crash, infinite loop, or memory consumption) via (a) unspecified vectors in the (1) AVI, (2) AVS, (3) DCM, (4) EPT, (5) FITS, (6) MTV, (7) PALM, (8) RLA, and (9) TGA decoder readers; and (b) the GetImageCharacteristics function in magick/image.c, as reachable from a crafted (10) PNG, (11) JPEG, (12) BMP, or (13) TIFF file.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: Heap-buffer overflow in IsPixelMonochrome
Vulnerabilities.Description: The IsPixelMonochrome function in MagickCore/pixel-accessor.h in ImageMagick 7.0.3.0 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (out-of-bounds read and crash) via a crafted file.  NOTE: the vendor says "This is a Q64 issue and we do not support Q64."

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: Memory leak in WritePICONImage function
Vulnerabilities.Description: The WritePICONImage function in coders/xpm.c in ImageMagick 7.0.6-4 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak) via a crafted file that is mishandled in an OpenPixelCache call.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: Memory leak in WritePICONImage function via mishandled AcquireSemaphoreInfo call
Vulnerabilities.Description: The WritePICONImage function in coders/xpm.c in ImageMagick 7.0.6-4 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak) via a crafted file that is mishandled in an AcquireSemaphoreInfo call.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: Memory allocation failure in AcquireMagickMemory (incomplete fix for  CVE-2016-8866)
Vulnerabilities.Description: The ReadPCXImage function in coders/pcx.c in ImageMagick 7.0.4.9 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (attempted large memory allocation and application crash) via a crafted file. NOTE: this vulnerability exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2016-8862 and CVE-2016-8866.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: CPU Exhaustion via crafted input file
Vulnerabilities.Description: In ImageMagick 7.0.8-11 Q16, a tiny input file 0x50 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x4c 0x36 0x38 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x36 0x1f 0x35 0x50 0x00 can result in a hang of several minutes during which CPU and memory resources are consumed until ultimately an attempted large memory allocation fails. Remote attackers could leverage this vulnerability to cause a denial of service via a crafted file.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: RCE (shell command injection) vulnerability in OpenBlob with --enable-pipes configured
Vulnerabilities.Description: A vulnerability was found in ImageMagick. This security flaw cause a remote code execution vulnerability in OpenBlob with --enable-pipes configured.

Vulnerabilities.Title: imagemagick: ImageMagick: Undefined Behavior
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick is free and open-source software used for editing and manipulating digital images. Prior to versions 6.9.13-27 and 7.1.2-1, there is undefined behavior (function-type-mismatch) in splay tree cloning callback. This results in a deterministic abort under UBSan (DoS in sanitizer builds), with no crash in a non-sanitized build. This issue has been patched in versions 6.9.13-27 and 7.1.2-1.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Security policy bypass via symbolic link
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-58 and 7.x before 7.1.2-33 does not properly account for symbolic links in the IsRightsAuthorizedByName security policy check, allowing configured policy restrictions to be bypassed. Local attackers who can create a symlink can point it at a policy-restricted path to evade the configured policy.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via invalid memory free in fx operation
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.0-20 before 7.1.2-32 contains an invalid memory free vulnerability in the fx operation that occurs when initialization of an FX runtime entry fails. Attackers can trigger the failed FX runtime initialization to cause an invalid free, resulting in memory corruption and application crashes.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in PNG encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the PNG encoder, which does not release allocated memory when libpng initialization fails. Attackers who can repeatedly trigger PNG encoding operations in which libpng initialization fails can exhaust memory and cause a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in GIF encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the GIF encoder because allocated memory is not released when color quantization fails during encoding. Attackers can supply images whose GIF conversion causes quantization to fail, leaking memory with each attempt and degrading availability.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in YUV encoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the YUV encoder, which fails to release allocated memory when a specific operation fails. Attackers can supply crafted input that triggers the failing encoder operation, leaking memory and potentially exhausting resources to cause a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via uncontrolled recursion in MVG decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains uncontrolled recursion in the MVG decoder that can exhaust the program stack. An attacker who controls a file name processed by ImageMagick can trigger a stack overflow that crashes the process, causing a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via stack overflow in MSL decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a stack overflow in the MSL decoder caused by an incorrect depth check that fails to limit recursion. Attackers can supply a set of crafted MSL images that exhaust the stack when one of them is read, crashing the process and causing a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via use-after-free in PDF writer
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a use after free vulnerability in the PDF writer when writing CMYK images with JPEG2000 compression. Attackers can supply a crafted CMYK image that, when written to PDF with JPEG2000 compression, causes freed memory to be reused, potentially crashing the process.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via memory leak in the -process option
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak vulnerability in the -process option that allows attackers to cause unreleased memory allocations by supplying certain arguments. Attackers can repeatedly invoke the -process option with crafted arguments to gradually exhaust memory and degrade service availability.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of service via use-after-free in the WBINFO decoder
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.2-30 before 7.1.2-32 contains a use after free vulnerability in the WBINFO decoder that occurs when a memory allocation fails during image decoding. Attackers can supply a crafted image that, when decoded under memory allocation failure conditions, causes freed memory to be reused, crashing the application.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Denial of Service via crafted PostScript file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick 7.1.1-31 before 7.1.2-32 contains a NULL pointer dereference in the PostScript decoder that is triggered when a policy limit is reached. Attackers can supply a crafted PostScript file for processing to crash the application, causing a denial of service.

Vulnerabilities.Title: ImageMagick: ImageMagick: Information disclosure via crafted PostScript file
Vulnerabilities.Description: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the PostScript decoder, which allocates a buffer one byte longer than the data it decoded. Attackers can supply a crafted PostScript file to expose a single uninitialized byte of memory contents.
